acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a company like Frasheski Construction for tile installation coordination offers several advantages over DIY project management. We bring expertise in material sourcing, scheduling multiple trades, troubleshooting unforeseen issues, and ensuring code compliance. This saves you time, reduces stress, and often prevents costly mistakes, ensuring a higher quality finish. The practical tradeoff is the financial investment for coordination versus the time and potential risks of self-management.
